propositions: A declarative metric registry must map each metric id to its lens, data source, compute logic, and confidence level so the CLI is written once and metrics can be added without modification
Metrics with no data must return an Unavailable state with both a non-empty reason field and an ISO-formatted accruing_since timestamp
Source and confidence labels must ride on every metric value to enable downstream aggregation to segregate high-confidence structural series from backfilled/classified values
The is_authoritative() function must return False for backfill_classified source and must exclude classified values from authoritative metric rollups
Every entry in the REGISTRY must have a unique id and be validated to ensure no duplicates exist
New metric signals should light up by populating their source without requiring any CLI changes
